rules.rule: A then B, same SpellEffectInfo (first of group) and same grouped effect mask
recipients union into m_UniqueTargetInfo; existing entry ORs effect bits; B never filters A
DEFAULT DEST/SRC selectors SetDst/SetSrc spell-wide m_targets (no effect mask)
DEST/SRC-referenced area/line read m_targets dst/src position (GetDstPos never null, even if !HasDst)
DEST_DEST and TRAJ: CheckDst() (dst := caster if none) then ModDst
UNIT_AND_DEST area: ModDst(referer) after the search; ModDst ASSERTs HasDst
LAST reference: last m_UniqueTargetInfo entry with bit (1 << first effect of group), else caster
AddDestTarget per effect snapshots m_targets dst after that effect's selectors and EffectType targets
m_targets is not reset between effects: later effects read earlier effects' dst/src
explicit mask folds A then B of each effect with shared srcSet/dstSet; UNIT_AND_DEST sets dstSet without requesting DEST_LOCATION
InitExplicitTargets: needed DEST without client dst -> explicit object position else caster; not needed -> RemoveDst (flag only); SRC likewise with caster
channel: after all selectors, m_channelTargetEffectMask gets the effect bit if any unique target carries it
REQUIRE_ALL_TARGETS checks only unit-object selector groups after both selectors
